1.explanation:
• Button/Button.mdx: defines the base Button API, existing size variants, and where the new xl and large size tokens need to be added and documented.
• ButtonSet/ButtonSet.mdx: covers how action buttons are grouped in footers and sidebars, ensuring the new sizes flow properly within the grouping component.
• Modal/Modal.mdx: shows the default Modal footer pattern and placement of primary/secondary actions, useful to verify the 80px xl variant displays correctly in a modal context.
• ComposedModal/ComposedModal.mdx: describes the composed modal layout used in the create flow, so we can confirm the new size does not break the modal’s spacing or CSS overrides.
• PrimaryButton/PrimaryButton.mdx: documents the default primary style, which the “Next” button uses, and where the height token change must propagate.
• SecondaryButton/SecondaryButton.mdx: included to verify secondary/cancel actions maintain consistent sizing relationships when a larger primary button is added.
1.bug_scenario:
The bug scenario centers on introducing two new size variants for the Button component: an “xl” size at 80px (10 rem) and a “large” size at 64px (8 rem). In the first spec image, a primary “Next” button is measured at 80px tall, and below that the default 64px tall version is shown with its 16px vertical padding offset. In the full-screen “Create topic” flow image, the modal’s footer bar contains “Cancel,” “Previous,” and “Next” actions. The “Next” button should render in the new 80px-high xl variant to match the design spec, rather than the current default height. Elements involved include: 
• Button (Primary variant) with dynamic height sizing
• ButtonSet or modal-footer container for grouping action buttons
• Modal/ComposedModal layout for the page’s create flow
• Padding/margin around each button (16px vertical offset)
• Typography inside the button (ensuring vertical centering in the larger container)
